fixes.explanation: Not this time, baker. Faith and family both start with F, so I get the mix-up. But no relatives show up in this scene. Notice what Jesus asks them first: "Do you believe that I am able to do this?" (Matthew 9:28). Then He touches their eyes and says, "According to your faith will it be done to you." (Matthew 9:29).

Yes, baker. The text says, "And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak." (Matthew 9:33). Just before that, he was mute and was brought to Jesus (Matthew 9:32). The crowds were amazed and said, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!" (Matthew 9:33). I bet that room got loud fast.

Not quite, baker, and I know a plain True can feel like a trick. I've been fooled by the easy ones myself, so no shame here! The text says, "And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak." (Matthew 9:33). He was mute before (Matthew 9:32), and now he talks, so True is the answer.
